title: Agreement of Clamped Head Movements
statement: Let $n,n'$ be natural numbers, let $p$ be a position among the $n+2$ head positions, and let $p'$ be a position among the $n'+2$ head positions. Suppose $p'$ and $p$ have the same value, $n'\le n$, and either $p\le n'$ or $n'=n$. For every sign $s\in\{-1,0,1\}$, moving from either position by $s$ with the respective boundary clamping gives equal values, and the resulting value is at most $p+1$.
hypotheses_covered: The values of $p'$ and $p$ are equal
